title: kb-docs.json
description: Manifest at the root of a kb-docs.tar.gz release artifact. Describes every app the archive publishes. See contract/ARTIFACT.md.

apps.description: One entry per app in the archive. A packaged documentation site is a list of one.

slug.description: Names the app's directory in the archive and its public URL prefix /knowledge-base/{slug}/. Must be unique across the whole knowledge base — prefix it with your service name.

name.description: Human-readable app name, shown on the catalog card and in the masthead.

description.description: One sentence, shown on the catalog card.

entryPoint.description: Landing page, relative to the app's directory in the archive.
entryPoint.$comment: Relative, forward-slashed, no traversal — enforced by the pattern below rather than by prose.

icon.description: Icon name from the supported set. An unrecognised value falls back to book-open rather than failing the build.

tags.description: Taxonomy tags shown as pills on the catalog card.

pages.description: Navigation manifest. When present it is the authoritative route list for the app and the knowledge base does not crawl the directory.

title.description: Human-readable page title used in navigation.

path.description: Path to the HTML file, relative to the app's directory in the archive.

order.description: Sort position within the app's navigation (lower sorts higher).

section.description: Optional group heading to display above this page.
